channel.title: Simple Actor
channel.description: Web scrapers I build, run and fix in production.

item.title: How to get past the Google Maps results limit (153 coffee shops in Austin became 471)
item.description: One Google Maps search for coffee shops in Austin stops at 153 places. Six neighbourhood searches found 471 distinct ones, for 42 cents. The code, the overlap, and what it costs.

item.title: How to get the email of every dentist in Miami from Google Maps
item.description: Google Maps lists 182 dentists for one Miami search and shows an email for none of them. One run found 81 addresses in five minutes for 31 cents. The code, the output, and where it falls short.
